content.title: The Players Championship: The “Fifth” Major is Back
content.text: The Players Championship is one of the most prestigious events on the PGA Tour. Often referred to as golf’s “fifth major,” this tournament attracts the world’s top players and delivers some of the most dramatic moments in the sport. With an iconic course, a record-breaking purse, and a field packed with talent, The Players Championship 2025 is not going to disappoint. Here’s everything you need to know about The Players Championship 2025. The Players Championship is one of the biggest events on the PGA Tour. Unlike the Masters, U.S. Open, Open Championship, or PGA Championship, it is not classified as an official major championship - but many consider it to be just as significant. Some even think it should be given full status. The event is known for its elite field and the arena upon which it is battled. The host course, TPC Sawgrass, a venue that has created some of the most memorable moments in golf history. With one of the most infamous and feared closing stretches in golf, it is always packed with drama. Where Does The Players Championship Take Place? ● Location: TPC Sawgrass, Ponte Vedra Beach, Florida ● Dates: March 13-16, 2025 ● Course: Stadium Course at TPC Sawgrass Designed by Pete Dye, this championship layout is best known for its signature 17th hole - The Island Green, a par 3 that has tested even the greatest players under pressure. Who Takes Part in The Players Championship? The Players Championship always boasts one of the strongest fields in golf if not the strongest out-with majors. Expect to see past champions and current stars such as Scottie Scheffler, Rory McIlroy, Ludvig Aberg, and Xander Schauffele playing for that famous golden trophy. The 2025 Players Championship field will be announced closer to the tournament date, but as always, only the best of the best will qualify. Who Won The Players Championship in 2024? The 2024 Players Championship was held at TPC Sawgrass, with Scottie Scheffler securing victory in dramatic fashion and by a single shot. His final-round heroics and steady putting on the 17th island green made for a thrilling finish, proving once again why he is one of the top names in golf. The Players Championship Prize Money ● Total Purse for 2025: Estimated to exceed $25 million ● Winner’s Share: Over $4.5 million The Players Championship has the largest prize fund of any regular PGA Tour event, making it one of the most lucrative tournaments of the year. Compared to The Masters, U.S. Open, and Open Championship, The Players consistently offers one of the biggest paydays in golf. What Makes The Players Championship Special? ● The Iconic 17th Hole: The Island Green at TPC Sawgrass is one of the most famous holes in golf, providing unforgettable drama every year. ● Elite Field: The Players Championship field is always an elite field. ● Massive Prize Fund: With a total purse exceeding $25 million, this is one of the most lucrative events in the sport. ● Perfect Timing: Positioned ahead of the majors, The Players Championship sets the stage for the season. Like many events that have a fixed home, the Players has moments of history in iconic spots. The course changes from year to year as modifications are made but the history remains. The 17th hole takes a lot of the attention, as it should, but this tournament is much more than a treacherous par 3. Welcome to Players Championship week.
